messages:
maya: Dropping a compact PRD draft for gen-stream edge handling. Want to lock MUST vs SHOULD vs MAY items before sprint planning. Quick thumbs or objections please.
chris: On it. I think we should divide by failure mode: network interrupts, backend restarts, token-limit cuts, and duplicate retries. Each needs one acceptance SLI and a test.
olivia: Agree. Also require clear user-visible signals for truncation vs resume so customers can react.
sam: Customer ask (PulseAI): deterministic resume when mobile clients reconnect. They want exactly-once continuation not duplicated tokens. Flag this high.
maya: Proposed priority order: 1) deterministic resume for common reconnects, 2) clear truncation contract + token accounting, 3) best-effort retry with idempotency hints.
harper: From QA: include UTF-8 boundary tests (no half-byte output), off-by-one token counting, and concurrent-resume contention tests (two clients reuse same resume token).
chris: Technical sketch for resume token: opaque, short-lived, HMAC-signed, includes model id, seq, and KV-checksum. Example: "hex:ver=01;seq=10234;kv=af3b;c=HMAC". Server verifies TTL and KV checksum before allowing resume.
olivia: SLIs proposal: resume_success_rate >= 99% for reconnects <= 30s; truncation_rate <= 0.5% of requests with informational flag; retry_duplication_rate <= 0.1%. Also need dashboard panels and alerts.
maya: Launch gates (GA): all MUST tests pass in staging with 2 weeks of chaos run, dashboards hooked in Console, and one paying customer beta verified.
sam: Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout: internal 3-day burn -> beta customers (3) for 2 weeks -> gradual region rollout with monitoring.
chris: Edge behaviors to enumerate (short list): 
- mid-token cutoff: must never return partial UTF-8 characters; decoder-safe truncation.
- resume after model variant swap: if resume token refers to older weights, return informative error and fallback path.
- backend 5xx vs idle stream timeout: treat 5xx as retryable but require backoff; idle stream timeout should surface resume token to client.
- request with changed permissions on reconnect: reject resume and surface auth error.
- prompt+prefix token accounting mismatch: server must validate pre-stream budget and abort with clear error.
harper: Tests to add to CI: packet-loss simulation, mid-stream process restart, model switch during an active stream, and fuzz resume tokens to ensure safe failure modes.
olivia: Security note: resume tokens must be HMACed per-customer key and TTL <= 5 minutes by default. Log token reuse events and surface to security team.
maya: UX question: should server dedupe retries if client does not provide idempotency-key? My take: only dedupe when client-supplied idempotency-key exists; otherwise best-effort backoff.
chris: Agreed. Document for function-calling: retries are at-least-once by default; clients should design idempotent tool interfaces or provide idempotency key. We'll document recommended patterns.
sam: For Vectorly pilot I'll collect a 500-request corpus that stresses mobile reconnects and long-lived streams. Assign me actions to coordinate.
harper: QA owners: @harper runs harness, @chris owns resume token impl, @olivia owns SLIs/dashboards.
maya: Action items: 
- chris: full spec for resume_token and error codes by EOD Thursday
- olivia: SLI definitions + Console dashboard mockups by Mon
- harper: QA harness + chaos tests in CI by next Thursday
- sam: customer test corpus and pilot plan by next Wed
Everyone: react with :thumbsup: when acked or comment inline.
deploy-bot: Feature flag created: ff.gen_stream_resume = disabled (staging only)
maya: Thanks. If no blocking comments I'll fold this into PRD and post to eng-sprint for prioritization.
chris: One more: possible future optimization — on truncation, optionally route to compact model to finish continuation. Mark as future work under Optimize track.
sam: +1 to future work. Keep GA focused.
maya: End. Add any final blockers here.
